title: Latency Beacon: cohort sampler and streaming/non-streaming flicker detector
text:
Latency Beacon: cohort sampler and streaming/non-streaming flicker detector

description:
Problem: We periodically see short-duration latency "flickers" that disproportionately affect tail SLIs for certain model+route combinations when the system switches between streaming and blocking io modes or when kernel scheduling changes. Current dashboards show aggregated p50/p95/p99 but lack an automated way to surface transient cohorts and collect traces for debugging.

Goal: Build a "Latency Beacon" subsystem that: (1) attaches a lightweight sampling score to requests in the router based on heuristics (io_mode transition, sudden increase in seq_len, concurrency spike, kernel variant); (2) samples extra telemetry and traces for affected cohorts; (3) emits denormalized metrics with tags {route, model, io_mode, request_shape, kernel_variant, sampling_cohort}; (4) powers a new dashboard that highlights regressions and shows p50/p95/p99 split by streaming vs non-streaming with trace links.

Design decisions and trade-offs: We will use reservoir sampling with prioritize-on-change (boost sampling when io_mode changes or when request_shape deviates >2 sigma). This increases trace volume temporarily but limits cost by decaying boosts. Alternative (uniform higher sampling) rejected due to metric storage cost. We will emit histograms with configurable buckets (log-scale) and rely on our metrics aggregator to compute percentiles. To avoid high-cardinality explosion, request_shape will be a hashed bucketed label (e.g., small/medium/large) and kernel_variant will be limited to the top-3 variants observed; others folded into "other".

Implementation plan: 
- Router trace hook: add hook to attach sampling_score and cohort_id tags at ingress.
- Metrics pipeline changes: new metric names redwood.request_latency_ms (histogram) and redwood.request_errors_total (counter) with tags. Add aggregation rules to compute p50/p95/p99 per model+route+io_mode.
- Dashboard: New board "Latency Beacon" with panels: cohort flame list, p50/p95/p99 grid, streaming vs non-streaming comparison, latency waterfall with trace links, cohort sample volume over time.
- Alerts & SLIs: Add temporary guardrails: p95(model,route,io_mode)>750ms for 10m triggers PagerDuty; create a low-severity alert for sampling rate spikes.

Rollout: feature-flagged per-cluster. Start with internal staging and a small subset of production routes (20 routes). Monitor cost and false positives for 2 weeks before wider rollout.

Artifacts: Confluence PRD: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Latency+Beacon, Design sketch: https://drive.redwood.ai/file/d/1LatencySketch, Implementation PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/2814 (router hook + sampling), Dashboard PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/432.

Open questions: 1) What decay window should we use for boosted sampling? (proposed 15m). 2) Should we keep a persistent cohort registry for historical correlation? (defer to storage/cost review).

acceptance_criteria:
New dashboard 'Latency Beacon' present in Console with panels for p50/p95/p99 by model+route and split by streaming vs non-streaming
Trace links from cohort rows open in the trace explorer to the sampled span
Router hook adds sampling_score and cohort_id tags to telemetry for flagged requests
Histogram metric redwood.request_latency_ms emitted with expected tags and aggregation rules produce comparable percentiles to raw traces
Sampling rate configurable via feature flag and defaults to low-volume for production; rollout path validated in staging
Load test demonstrating sampling overhead <3% CPU and <7% network cost increase for sampled traffic

progress_updates:
2026-02-11: Kickoff meeting with Observability, Router, and Runtime teams. Agreed on boosted reservoir sampling approach.
2026-02-16: Router hook prototype implemented (branch: feat/latency-beacon-hook). Added sampling_score tag and cohort_id generation. Initial unit tests pass.
2026-02-20: Metrics pipeline config drafted; histogram buckets chosen (5,10,20,50,100,200,500,1000,2000 ms). Sending draft to infra for capacity estimate.
2026-02-24: UX review with Console PM (Elena Rossi) — requested a compact grid + sparkline for cohort rows. Updated dashboard wireframe.
2026-02-28: Integration tests failing intermittently on staging due to high-cardinality tags from rare kernel_variant values. Implemented top-3 gating in router and replaced low-frequency variants with 'other' tag. Re-running tests.
